description: Controlled vocabulary for the 'proxy' field. 'validates' = which model component the proxy can test (default for rate_type). 'timescale' = typical integration time class. Add new proxies here before extracting them.

mem.label: Micro-erosion meter (MEM)
mem.note: Bare-rock surface lowering; dominated by dissolution, may include granular disintegration / bioerosion.

tmem.label: Traversing micro-erosion meter (TMEM)
tmem.note: As MEM, more points per station.

dated_structure.label: Surfaces of known age (gravestones, buildings, archaeology)

reef_terrace.label: Lowering of dated uplifted reef terraces

cosmogenic_36cl.label: In-situ 36Cl in carbonate
cosmogenic_36cl.note: CIRCULARITY WARNING: the empirical model is calibrated on 36Cl. Tag records used in the regression in notes ('calibration_set') so they can be held out.

cosmogenic_10be_catchment.label: Catchment-averaged 10Be in river quartz
cosmogenic_10be_catchment.note: Quartz-based: only meaningful for carbonate if carbonate_fraction is known; quartz sourced from non-carbonate parts biases the rate.

cosmogenic_10be_chert.label: In-situ 10Be in chert / quartz in carbonate

paleokarst.label: Missing section at dated exposure surfaces

erosion_pin.label: Erosion pins (rock or regolith surface)
erosion_pin.note: On bare rock mostly chemical; on residuum/soil includes physical removal - set rate_type per site.

profile_gauge.label: Rock profile gauge / profilometer (non-MEM contact or laser profiling)
profile_gauge.note: Repeat surface profiles on bare rock; similar use to MEM but different instrument and precision.

radiocarbon_dated_surface.label: Surface lowering constrained by 14C / other ages of exhumed or dated surfaces (e.g. fault scarps)
